paper.title: MCMICRO: a scalable, modular image-processing pipeline for multiplexed tissue imaging
paper.baseline: MCMICRO reproducibly converts multiplexed tissue images into registered mosaics, segmentation masks and spatial feature tables suitable for downstream phenotyping and spatial analysis.

minimumEvidence: registration and channel identity are checked before phenotyping
segmentation quality is quantified and visually inspected
cell phenotypes are supported by marker combinations rather than one threshold
spatial enrichment is compared with a density-preserving or permutation baseline
single-specimen findings are reported as candidates with a validation plan

requiredResults: reusable spatial feature table or AnnData object
TeX source, BibTeX and paper-style PDF
